# RedSan Digitals (RedSan)

> RedSan (Redsan Digitals Pvt. Ltd.) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified Full-Stack Digital Marketing, SEO, Performance Marketing, and MarTech Engineering Agency founded in 2019. Headquartered in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, RedSan serves enterprise, D2C, and high-growth clients across Delhi NCR, Noida, Gurugram, Chandigarh, Rishikesh, and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Growth Services
- [Digital Marketing Agency](https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency/): Full-stack commercial growth partner, marketing funnels, and enterprise brand building.
- [SEO, AEO & GEO Strategy](https://redsan.in/seo-agency/): Advanced technical search engine optimization, AI answer engine optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude), generative engine optimization, schema architecture, and high-authority PR backlinks.
- [Performance Marketing](https://redsan.in/performance-marketing/): High-ROAS paid customer acquisition, full-funnel CRO, audience segmentation, and multi-touch attribution.
- [Google Ads (PPC)](https://redsan.in/google-ads/): Certified Google Ads management across Search, Shopping, Performance Max (PMax), and YouTube ads.
- [Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)](https://redsan.in/meta-ads/): Paid social scale, creative velocity testing, Conversions API (CAPI) server-side tracking, and remarketing.
- [Social Media & Video Production](https://redsan.in/social-media-marketing/): Studio-grade short-form video (Reels, Shorts), UGC production, on-site shoots, and brand grid management.
- [Website Development & CRO](https://redsan.in/website-development/): Sub-second speed web development, custom applications, startup MVPs, vibe coding, and conversion rate optimization.
- [AI Marketing & MarTech](https://redsan.in/ai-marketing/): WhatsApp API automation, AI agent workflows, prompt engineering, predictive analytics, and lead routing.

## Regional Service Hubs & Local Dominance
- [Dehradun Digital Marketing Agency](https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency-dehradun/): Primary headquarters and flagship agency in Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
- [Rishikesh Digital Marketing Agency](https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency-rishikesh/): Hospitality, wellness, adventure, and local business digital marketing in Rishikesh.
- [Noida Digital Marketing Agency](https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency-noida/): Tech corridor, B2B SaaS, and corporate growth agency in Noida Sector 62 / Expressway.
- [Delhi Digital Marketing Agency](https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency-delhi/): Enterprise growth, D2C scale, and lead generation across Delhi NCR.
- [Gurugram Digital Marketing Agency](https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency-gurugram/): Cyber City, Golf Course Road, and startup ecosystem growth engineering in Gurugram.
- [Chandigarh Digital Marketing Agency](https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency-chandigarh/): Tricity digital marketing, export, healthcare, and education marketing in Chandigarh.

## Education & Masterclasses
- [MarTech Masterclass & Workshops](https://redsan.in/workshops/): Flagship intensive 2-day live workshop covering Digital Marketing with AI, Entrepreneurship, and Sales Closing for ₹49. Over 500+ students trained across Graphic Era, DIT, and UPES.
